Root cause: clickhouse-2 is stuck in ContainerCreating because the storage array has reached max LUN mappings. The CSI driver error shows: "host group hg-k8s-prod reached max LUN mappings (512)".

Evidence: MountVolume.MountDevice failed - the persistent volume data-clickhouse-2 cannot be attached to node ip-10-0-93-12 due to storage array cv-array-02 capacity limits.

Fix: Storage team must clean up unused LUN mappings on cv-array-02's host group hg-k8s-prod to free capacity. Once done, the pod will automatically retry and transition to Running.
